description: Current real-time snapshot for a site: live visitor count, top pages right now, current top referrers, active sessions, etc. Use for 'what's happening on the site right now', 'who's currently on the checkout page', 'how many visitors live'.

categories.description: Subset of the 20 live categories to include. Omit to get all categories. Smaller subsets are faster.

site_id.description: Site ID. Get it from list_sites if you don't know it.
